summary: Resolved DS2-R1 by parsing quoted Yarn Berry selectors and quoted pnpm package keys, preserving lockfile exact-version precedence over package.json declarations.

resolutions.result: The lock resolver accepts quoted package selectors and version values, including Berry npm selectors and pnpm v9 package entries; it now returns the exact locked version before consulting package.json.

validation.command: corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular build && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular test && corepack yarn workspace @code2youlabs/angular check
validation.details: 30 Angular tests passed, including two regression fixtures where a quoted lockfile resolves incompatible 3.4.0 despite a compatible ^4.3.0 package declaration.
